Title: Project Setup and Architecture Design
Description: Set up the initial project structure and define the overall architecture for Enhanced project specification for: a comprehensive wifi monitor for my home. This includes selecting the technology stack, setting up version control, and establishing coding standards.
Acceptance Criteria: Project repository created and initialized; Technology stack documented and approved; Architecture diagram created; Development environment setup guide documented; CI/CD pipeline configured
Technical Notes: Consider scalability, maintainability, and team expertise when selecting technologies. Use industry best practices for project structure.
Blockers: Technology stack approval needed; Infrastructure access required

Title: Core Feature Implementation - Phase 1
Description: Implement the primary functionality described in the project requirements. Focus on the MVP (Minimum Viable Product) features that deliver core value.
Acceptance Criteria: Core features implemented and functional; Unit tests written with >80% coverage; Code reviewed and approved; Documentation updated; Integration tests passing
Technical Notes: Follow SOLID principles and maintain clean code standards. Implement proper error handling and logging.

Title: User Interface and Experience Design
Description: Design and implement the user interface with focus on usability, accessibility, and responsive design. Create wireframes and mockups before implementation.
Acceptance Criteria: UI mockups created and approved; Responsive design implemented; Accessibility standards met (WCAG 2.1); Cross-browser compatibility verified; User testing completed
Technical Notes: Use modern CSS frameworks and ensure mobile-first design. Implement proper semantic HTML.

Title: Database Schema and Data Layer
Description: Design and implement the database schema, data models, and data access layer. Ensure proper indexing, relationships, and data integrity.
Acceptance Criteria: Database schema designed and documented; Migrations created and tested; Data models implemented; Database indexes optimized; Backup and recovery procedures documented
Technical Notes: Consider data normalization, query performance, and future scalability. Implement proper connection pooling.
Blockers: Database server access; Data migration from legacy systems

Title: Authentication and Authorization System
Description: Implement secure user authentication and role-based authorization system. Include password management, session handling, and security best practices.
Acceptance Criteria: User registration and login implemented; Password hashing and security measures in place; Role-based access control working; Session management implemented; Security audit completed
Technical Notes: Use industry-standard authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, JWT). Implement rate limiting and brute force protection.
Blockers: Security requirements approval; Third-party auth provider setup

Title: API Development and Documentation
Description: Develop RESTful or GraphQL APIs with comprehensive documentation. Implement proper versioning, error handling, and rate limiting.
Dependencies: ISSUE-002: Core Features; ISSUE-004: Database Schema
Acceptance Criteria: API endpoints implemented and tested; API documentation generated (Swagger/OpenAPI); Rate limiting implemented; API versioning strategy in place; Error responses standardized
Technical Notes: Follow REST best practices or GraphQL specifications. Implement proper HTTP status codes and error messages.
Blockers: API design approval; Third-party API dependencies

Title: Testing Strategy and Implementation
Description: Develop comprehensive testing strategy including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests. Set up automated testing pipeline.
Acceptance Criteria: Unit test coverage >80%; Integration tests implemented; E2E tests for critical paths; Test automation in CI/CD; Performance tests completed
Technical Notes: Use appropriate testing frameworks (Jest, Pytest, Selenium). Implement test data management strategy.
Blockers: Testing environment setup; Test data preparation

Title: Performance Optimization
Description: Optimize application performance including database queries, API response times, frontend rendering, and resource loading.
Dependencies: ISSUE-002: Core Features; ISSUE-006: API Development
Acceptance Criteria: Performance benchmarks established; Database queries optimized; Caching strategy implemented; Frontend assets optimized; Load testing completed
Technical Notes: Use profiling tools to identify bottlenecks. Implement caching at multiple layers (CDN, application, database).
Blockers: Performance requirements definition; Load testing environment

Title: Security Hardening and Compliance
Description: Implement security best practices, conduct security audit, and ensure compliance with relevant standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.).
Acceptance Criteria: Security audit completed; Vulnerabilities addressed; Data encryption implemented; Compliance requirements met; Security documentation updated
Technical Notes: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines. Implement proper input validation, output encoding, and SQL injection prevention.
Blockers: Security audit scheduling; Compliance requirements clarification

Title: Monitoring and Logging Infrastructure
Description: Set up comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting system to track application health, performance, and errors.
Acceptance Criteria: Logging framework implemented; Monitoring dashboards created; Alert rules configured; Error tracking system integrated; Performance metrics tracked
Technical Notes: Use centralized logging (ELK stack, CloudWatch). Implement structured logging with correlation IDs.

Title: Deployment and DevOps Setup
Description: Configure production deployment pipeline, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment processes.
Acceptance Criteria: Deployment pipeline automated; Infrastructure as code implemented; Blue-green or canary deployment configured; Rollback procedures documented; Production environment secured
Technical Notes: Use containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Implement proper secrets management.
Blockers: Production environment access; DevOps tool approval

Title: Documentation and Knowledge Transfer
Description: Create comprehensive documentation including technical documentation, user guides, API documentation, and deployment guides.
Dependencies: ISSUE-002: Core Features; ISSUE-006: API Development
Acceptance Criteria: Technical documentation completed; User guides written; API documentation published; Deployment runbook created; Knowledge transfer sessions conducted
Technical Notes: Use documentation tools (Confluence, GitBook). Keep documentation in version control.
